ui.common.layout.toasts.dismiss.role: accessible name of the close button on a toast
ui.common.layout.toasts.dismiss.tone: verb phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.common.layout.toasts.dismiss.note: The toast region is a live region; every toast carries the same close control, so the name must not include the toast's own message. Supplied to the toaster rather than left to the component's English default.

ui.common.layout.toasts.notifications.role: accessible name of the toast region itself
ui.common.layout.toasts.notifications.tone: plural noun, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.common.layout.toasts.notifications.note: The toaster appends the keyboard shortcut to this name, so it must read as a region label on its own and carry no punctuation or shortcut of its own.
